Requests.Title: Glorious Victor!
Requests.Story:
The world ultimately belongs to the victor.
That is the only thing I learned while working
in various governments and organizations.

The mission I have for you is simple. All you have to do is win...
Make the weak crumble before you and leave the victor.
I will give you a prize worthy of your accomplishment.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Necessity
Requests.Story:
Don't think that being a mercenary like me is easy. Greenhorns can't handle the pressure. Without the skills needed for popping heads, no one will ever hire you. 

Yeah, that's right, headshots are a necessity for killers.

Still, you seem to have the nerve needed to pull the trigger when it counts.
It just so happens I have a job with a pretty good prize. So, are you a killer?

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Perfect Headshot
Requests.Story:
Accuracy is essential for a soldier.
If you lack the skill to eliminate an enemy with one headshot it puts your own life in danger.

Now, this fodder shouldn't be too much trouble, show me some real precision.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: C4 Plan Support
Requests.Story:
There's a big problem. The troops in the operation area have requested emergency support because their C4 specialist has gone missing.
You seem to have experience with handling a C4 bomb.

Report to the battleground and carry out their C4
plan. I will contact the active force and let them know you are on your way.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.
Requests.Text: Plant or defuse 3 bombs in Original modes

Requests.Title: Hostage Rescue
Requests.Story:
The Terrorists are at it again. The extremes one must go to in order to make their message known,
I know their struggle...
Aah, never mind. Ignore what I just said. I will give you the mission that just came down from the government.

Please rescue the hostages that are being detained by the Terrorists. It's an urgent mission so I'm sure your reward will be worth it.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Important Indeed
Requests.Story:
When you're in business, there are times when you simply have to be cold hearted. Eliminating your rivals is often just a sound investment.
But would you even understand my line of work if there isn't a trigger to pull? 

Don't worry, I compensate even my lowest of associates well for their unique talents...

Go to the Oilrig and eliminate the VIP. It's not important for you to know who he is.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Grenade Toss
Requests.Story:
Soldier! It's an important skill to assess the situation and make adequate responses. In standoff situations, a well placed grenade is a very adequate response.

This Mission will require skill with explosives. Go to the battlefield and effectively use grenades to subdue the enemy. 

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.
Requests.Text: Score 1 grenade kills in Original, Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch

Requests.Title: Weapon Expert
Requests.Story:
I want to work with you on this job, so listen up: the client for this job has made an interesting request. The important thing is that you're able to use a pistol and knife effortlessly, just as I can.

Your job is to eliminate one opponent with a pistol and another with a knife.

You do... own a pistol and knife right?

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.
Requests.Text: Score 1 melee kills in Original, Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch; Score 1 pistol kills in Original, Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch

Requests.Title: 1 vs 100
Requests.Story:
Soldier! Don't forget that war isn't fought with headcount alone. A competent soldier can outmatch 100 enemies all by himself.

The battle is not going well for us so I'll need you to pick up the slack.

I trust that you'll return after eliminating at least 5 enemies without falling in battle.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Heroism
Requests.Story:
We at Aegis Institute are investigating the Hero that helped us greatly against the zombies. Because those disgusting zombies have the ability to evolve, we cannot be careless in our research towards enhancing the Hero’s abilities.

Such research is difficult because we lack information from real battles.

If you can bring us real combat data on the Hero, it would be vital to our research.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Clinical Trial
Requests.Story:
The effect of the morale booster was what helped us counter-attack those nauseating zombies. At Aegis Institute, we're analyzing the effects of the morale booster in order to destroy zombies more effectively.

Of course, the problem is... Yes. It's the lack of data. If you can come back to us after fully experiencing the morale booster that info will be priceless.

* This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Economical Battle
Requests.Story:
Have you heard the phrase 'a penny saved is a penny earned'? It means that money, however small, can become a fortune when it's pooled together. That's why being frugal is so important.

We can see how wasteful you are with bullets when killing zombies. If you can put down zombies without wasting any ammunition then that's just good sense.

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.
Requests.Text: Score 3 melee kills in Zombie (Original, Mutation, Hero)

Requests.Title: Eliminate the Host
Requests.Story:
Hey rookie, how much do you know about zombies? Heheh... I have quite a bit of experience toying with zombies. You at least know to eliminate the host first in order to kill all of them, right? That's the fastest way to weaken them...

Rookie, this mission is to eliminate the host.
So how about it? It's been a while since I've played with zombies. Let's have some fun!

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Dead Drop
Requests.Story:
This is big trouble. We've received communication that zombies have infested district B7 again. I think we're going to have to send over a supply box, but it's going to be a nasty operation because of those zombies.

We need your help. Retrieve the supply box amidst the crowd of zombies.
It'll be a big help during combat as well.

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Dangerous Alliance
Requests.Story:
An interesting world, isn't it? There's even a time when zombies and humans must be allies in battle. They are always
at each other's throat, how long will they go on pretending to be friends? Such a dangerous alliance will only end in betrayal.

Now, I have a request. Show me a hint of that betrayal.
 Proof that it is merely fate that humans
must kill zombies and zombies must kill humans...
 

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.
Requests.Text: Kill 10 zombies in Zombie (Original, Mutation, Hero); Infect 10 humans in Zombie (Original, Mutation, Hero)

Requests.Title: Juggernaut Hunt
Requests.Story:
This is a desperate situation. We heard that Juggernauts, the giant zombies that appeared in the Lost City, are spreading out to other areas. The Juggernauts are wreaking havoc in these areas and if we don't put a stop to it many lives will be at risk.

You've got more experience than anyone with these creatures, you're our best bet. Go and put those Juggernauts down for good!

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Public Interest
Requests.Story:
A fool spends money only for himself with no interest in his fellow man. It's smart business to invest in the common good knowing it will return profit for himself.

The same goes for soldiers like you. If you have done your part with the Barrier Wall Upgrade in the Double Gate area, I would be inclined to invest in you too.

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Eliminate the Titan
Requests.Story:
Soldier! I hate to admit it but we are at a disadvantage in this operation. If we want to get rid of the Vanguard Company soldiers, eliminating the commanding officer is the best route.

You must go to the battlefront and eliminate the Titan. Yes, I mean those huge masked men charging with the minigun!

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
*  Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Air Strike Support
Requests.Story:
Although the purpose of Aegis Institute is to halt zombie expansion, the Vanguard Company is no less of an enemy with their disruption to our research.
That's why this guidance system was developed.

Your mission is to deliver the air strike coordinates at the battle site. When you deliver the coordinates, the bomber on our side will attack.

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Universal Player
Requests.Story:
This is a really big problem... We have a football game at our base this afternoon, but one of our players is on leave so we need to fill a position.

What? Will you really play for our team?

Great! If you can deliver an outstanding performance, I'll see to it that you're rewarded.

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.
Requests.Text: Win 1 matches in Soccer; Play 2 matches in Soccer

Requests.Title: Occupy the Base
Requests.Story:
Well, we have an annoying problem... Sometimes a minor dispute can grow into a big fight. Sure, fighting each other is fine but not when it damages the company, right? Go and subdue the defense system.

It's simple. Subdue the hostile guardian and secure a few bases.

*This mission can only be completed in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Zombie Sweep
Requests.Story:
What's vital for controlling the damage caused by the zombies is to regularly reduce their population. Who knows? Maybe starting small can eventually lead to the extermination of the zombies!

Maybe...
You don't look opposed to the task in any case.

* Can be achieved only in a room with 4 or more players.
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: First Steps 1
Requests.Story:
Soldier, as you know, your First Step is always the most important! Now stand up and do something! 
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: First Steps 2
Requests.Story:
I'm pretty sure you know what to do! What are you looking at? Don't stop now!
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: First Steps 3
Requests.Story:
Good job, soldier! You probably feel more confident now. But that's no reason for you to be arrogant!
* Unclaimed prizes will disappear when the mission has been reset.

Requests.Title: Aura of an expert
Requests.Story:
The numbers of those grotesque zombies aren't decreasing. We need to take a stable defensive position.
However, we lack the number of experts who can help us out. We need your help.
If you can become an expert through experience that is the best way. Please help out.

* Can be only completed in a room with 2 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.

Requests.Title: Shopaholic
Requests.Story:
Through our efforts, our position has become more fortified against attacks, but we can't be satisfied here. We'll need to be on our toes.
From what I hear, a Black Market was open while the zombie forces took a hit. Please go over there and buy weapons.
With them, we can fortify our position even further. Hurry.

* Can be only completed in a room with 4 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.

Requests.Title: Recharging the fighting spirit
Requests.Story:
One of the reasons why we were able to push the zombie forces back and go on the counter attack was our recharged fighting spirit. Aegis Institute is preparing to study ways to eliminate zombies more effectively by studying this effect.
The problem is that we don't have enough data.
If you can experience this effect first-hand by going into their lair, there won't be any data that can compare.

* Can be only completed in a room with 4 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.

Requests.Title: Virus Host
Requests.Story:
You've almost become a Super Soldier now. However, we cannot be satisfied yet.
With the research that has been carried out, you now have an ability to infect others with the virus.
Now, the time has come. It will be a new era for us. Go forth and infect those lowly humans, so that they will become one of us. Show us your abilities.

* Can be only completed in a room with 4 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.
Requests.Text: Infect 10 humans in Zombie (Original, Mutation, Hero)

Requests.Title: Master of Supply refill
Requests.Story:
We're in a dire situation here. We've received a report that zombies have resurfaced in Zone B7. We'll need to send them supplies but it looks like it'll be hard due to the area being overrun by zombies.

We need your help.
Please send them Supply Boxes by going through the area.
It'll be of great help in battle.

* Can be only completed in a room with 4 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.
Requests.Text: Play 3 matches in Zombie (Original, Mutation, Hero)

Requests.Title: Payback via air
Requests.Story:
Looks like you're getting used to special grenades.
If we are to expand our forces, we'll need to familiarize ourselves with this.
Go, show us what you can do.

* Can be only completed in a room with 4 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.

Requests.Title: Hawkeye
Requests.Story:
In order to become a better agent, you must be able to tell the real from the fake.
 In midst of the zombie crowd, there are zombies infected with virus that enables the host to keep its intellects.
 Go and eliminate the 'real' zombies.

* Can be only completed in a room with 4 or more people.
* Uncollected rewards will vanish upon reset.

Events.Description: Command wants marksmen. Every clean headshot this week counts toward the operation.

Infect 50 humans in any zombie mode
Win 5 matches in any zombie mode
Play 10 matches in any zombie mode
